clips.title: The story
paras: The Great Outdoors is an introductory wilderness survival quest where the traveler Sam teaches fledgling adventurers the art of roughing it in the wild. By pausing to rest beside a basic campfire, travelers learn how to sustain themselves on the road before pursuing specialized tradeskills.

The wide lands of Azeroth call to countless restless souls seeking fortune, danger, and renown. Yet raw ambition alone cannot shield a fledgling adventurer from the biting cold or exhaustion of the open road. Mastering basic wilderness craft—knowing when to stop, build a fire, and gather one's strength—is the quiet foundation upon which every legendary journey is built. Sam's invitation offers newcomers a chance to pause and learn these essential outdoor survival habits.

Taking shelter beside a warm campfire does more than stave off the night chill; it provides a vital moment of recuperation known as boosted rest. Seasoned survivalists recognize that endurance in the wild depends on resting properly between expeditions. Once these survival basics are understood, craftsmen and gatherers can turn their attention to tradeskills, learning how to assemble dedicated camp fixtures tailored to their specific work out in the field.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well howdy there, adventurer. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.
Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Having the skills needed to survive the outdoors is critical. A well-rested and well-prepared adventurer has a much higher chance of surviving this lifestyle.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
